trainer/30692.htm.text: Master Stedmiel: Have you been to the Enchanted Valley? They say that there are still Fairies secretly living there. In the ancient Elmoreden Empire, Fairies were hunted as exotic trinkets. Finally they fled into the deepest recesses of the forest there... If those legends are true, how fearful the…

trainer/30692-noteach.htm.text: Master Stedmiel: Unfortunately I can only teach Elven Fighters. There are many excellent teachers in this village so keep looking, you'll find the right one. May the blessing of starligh be with you.

Q00241_PossessorOfAPreciousSoul1/30692-0.text: Master Stedmiel: You must mean the Poetry Book with the stories of Beleth. I had forgotten about it, it was such a long time ago. A poet at the time collected the stories of old heroes. This is important work you are doing! Here's the book.
Master Stedmiel: Did you deliver the Poetry Book to Talien yet? This is the only copy, so be extra careful. Tell Talien I expect the best.
Master Stedmiel: I hope Talien's work bears fruit. Hearing the stories of old heroes will help people know their own ideals. Tell him I have great expectations!

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
